## Plan

Approach chosen for (a): **external HTTPS Application Load Balancer + serverless NEG → `sig-web`**
(NOT a Cloud Run domain mapping). Empirically forced: under the operator-armed ADC (account
`14SteveVitali@gmail.com`, project `zeta-medley-508121-u7`), `gcloud beta run domain-mappings create`
**errors** — the domain is not verified for the account and verification (`gcloud domains verify` /
Site Verification API) needs an interactive Search Console step + the `siteverification` scope the
cloud-platform ADC lacks (both confirmed 2026-09-23). The LB path needs **no** domain verification,
so it is the only path that can be *created now* and yields a **real reserved static IP** as the
apex/`www` `A` value — fulfilling the gate's "apply the mapping now, real values from real created
resources." Cost trade-off (~$18/mo forwarding rule + IP) is a conscious low-cost departure from
SIG-STORE-003, consistent with the ADR-081 precedent; ADR-098 records it with a zero-cost-migration
revisit trigger. The Cloud Run `*.run.app` origin stays the documented fallback.

- `ops/gcp/config.sh`: add `SIG_WEB_DOMAIN`/`SIG_WEB_DOMAIN_WWW` (public config; env-overridable) + the
  eight LB resource names; point probe URL defaults at the domain (run.app fallback documented).
- `ops/gcp/domain-mapping.sh` (new): idempotent LB IaC — reserve global IP, serverless NEG → sig-web,
  backend, managed multi-domain cert (apex+www), HTTPS url map (default apex backend; www→apex 301),
  HTTPS proxy, HTTP→HTTPS redirect url map + proxy, :443/:80 forwarding rules. `--check`/`--dry-run`
  prints the plan with no ADC/network and exits 0 (lib.sh `run`/`require_adc` pattern); `--apply`
  creates for real under ADC.
- `ops/cadence.toml`: `sig-web-root` + `sig-api-root` probe comments → the canonical domain; add an
  apex uptime target; keep run.app as documented fallback (no host literal baked — `url_env`).
- `web/astro.config.mjs`: verify `site` (P27.6 set it) — expected no-op.
- ADR-098 + Appendix F row + BUILD.sh + adr-index + BACKLOG BL-056 source cell.
- `tests/ops/test_gcp_iac.py`: register `domain-mapping.sh` in the parse/dry-run/no-literal lists +
  a domain-specific assertion.
- Apply under ADC; capture the real static IP; produce the exact Squarespace records.
- PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST national section: the HG-11 DNS gate action; DEFERRALS D-P27.10-1 + RETURN PASS.

## Evidence report

**What was applied vs deferred.** The custom-domain mapping is **applied for real** under the
operator-armed ADC: an external HTTPS Application Load Balancer + serverless NEG (ADR-098) fronts the
`sig-web` Cloud Run service at `https://surveillancegraph.org` (+ `www`→apex, HTTP→HTTPS) with a
Google-managed multi-domain certificate. The reserved static IP **136.81.80.102** is the real,
realized apex/`www` `A`-record value — not a template. The LB `:80` data path is live-verified
(301→HTTPS with host routing). The IaC is idempotent (`--check` green without ADC; re-apply skips
every create).

**Why the LB, not a Cloud Run domain mapping.** Empirically forced: under the available ADC the
domain-mapping create errors (the domain is unverified) and Search Console verification needs an
interactive step + a scope the cloud-platform ADC lacks. The LB needs no verification and is the only
path that can be applied now with real values — fulfilling the operator's gate answer "Apply domain
mapping now." Cost ~$18/mo is a conscious low-cost departure from SIG-STORE-003 (ADR-081 precedent),
with a documented zero-cost-migration revisit trigger.

**The gate-pending remainder (honest, not fabricated).** Google-managed TLS + `sig-ops probe-hosted`
on the custom domain provision only after the operator adds the two `A` records at Squarespace (apex
`@` `A` → `136.81.80.102`, `www` `A` → `136.81.80.102`; no verification TXT) and DNS resolves — the
HG-11 / Go-public human step, never auto-ticked. Held as RETURN PASS `D-P27.10-1`. The domain serves
the OKC demo until the national deploy `D-P27.8-1` lands (operator-accepted). No live TLS/probe green
is claimed.
